method: Read by eye from film strips at 12.5 fps; no ball, so 'contact' is the racket passing the front of the body during the fast forward swing, about +-0.1 s. Start/end are contact -0.8 s and +0.7 s, not individually marked.
notes: Two shadow one-handed backhands, both finishing with the hitting hand high above the head (the serve-like finish). The first is preceded by a slow, paused demonstration of the backswing (about 4-12.6 s) that is not a stroke.

strokes.notes: hand held in front from about 11.6 to 12.6 s, then swung to the finish
